title: An item that adds or changes a backlog.py verb, flag or refusal carries the facade's usage text and the skills that run that command in its touches
goal: Retrospective of SP-qxcj7fgy: three workers added verbs or flags (gate remove, gate host-unchecked, answer --free) or a refusal (new --sprint without --touch) with the usage docstring of _tools/backlog.py and the skills that run the command outside their touches, so they filed BG-5orqmy7i and BG-77i2lwmr for the usage text and the review found ST-j743ue7u and ST-tvnxvfjp for the skills. backlog.py check warns of an item whose goal names a new backlog.py verb or flag, or a new refusal, without _tools/backlog.py and the skills that run that command (backlog.py referrers) in its touches, as plan step 2 asks for every consumer of a changed tool route.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","priority":"P3","goal":"backlog.py gate retitle ID GATE is a new verb that rewords a gate","touches":["_tools/bl_items.py"],"checks":[{"run":["python3","_tools/backlog.py","check"]}]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); r("fmt"); p=r("check"); sys.exit(0 if any("ST-testtest" in l and "touches" in l and "_tools/backlog.py" in l for l in (p.stdout+p.stderr).splitlines()) else 1)

notes: Merged from ST-4oe42lzk “backlog.py check warns of an item whose goal adds a backlog.json setting or routes calls through another module without that file in its touches” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Goal-implied-touches warning of the same genre as ST-pntfa6ry, ST-2t3wqbnm and ST-eonnt2bt; its docs clause is already warned by bl_plan.docs_warnings (touches name the code, map.csv docs outside scope) and bl_check has facade/goal-path/named-test-file warnings; only the backlog.json-setting and bl_forge-routing triggers are new. Its goal: check warns, for an open item, when its goal names a new setting and its touches lack backlog.json, or names a module its calls go through (such as bl_forge) that its touches lack, or changes a _tools module whose kb/_self/map.csv docs (kb/_self/code.md) its touches lack; in SP-dqkf3i42 five of nine tasks had touches widened at dispatch and two workers stopped on a gate or a patch for a file outside them (TK-g4c5kxsc backlog.json, TK-uwu2lgvo bl_forge.py, ST-zmepvwav test_backlog_portable.py) Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "check_touches_setting_module"]} Its touches: _tools/bl_check.py, kb/_self/backlog.md, kb/_self/tools.md Merged from ST-gnp2p4p2 “Sprint planning maps a new command's skill consumer into an item” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Near-duplicate (0.62) of ST-pntfa6ry: both ask planning to put the skill that runs a changed command into touches. Single occurrence (SP-yojt6y7v census judge); a pure planning rule. Its goal: When a committed item adds a command a skill should run (census.py judge for /kb-census), planning puts that skill in some item's touches with a clause that the skill runs it (SP-yojt6y7v's review found the kb-census skill never runs the batch judge, so the end-to-end census ran it by hand). Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/selfdoc.py", "check"]} Its touches: .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, kb/_self/backlog.md
